candidateSource.title: Vapor-liquid equilibrium of the carbon dioxide/methane mixture at three isotherms

implementationAudit.nativeBridgeSupport: A generic diagnostic binary VLE bridge now supports EOS-CG CO2+CH4 with Helmholtz chemical-potential equality, pressure equality, fixed liquid methane composition and optional initial guesses.
implementationAudit.providerSupport: TeqpProvider exposes only density for CO2+CH4 mixtures.

productionDecision.reason: The corrected diagnostic VLE equations converge against the Petropoulou ThermoML matrix, but production phase-envelope tracing, production initial-guess/continuation policy and provider capability gating are not complete in this checkpoint.
